overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long CRM Daily ETF (CRMG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of CRM stock, less fees, and expenses. The fund uses derivatives to pursue its objective, holdings are used as collateral. CRMG was launched on Apr 4, 2025 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
